protocol.primary: Fixed 18 paired tasks, balanced per fixture; all completed pairs enter latency regardless of quality; stratified paired mean bootstrap CI. Quality scored independently. No significance stopping or retries.
protocol.qualityCriteria: Exact fixture answers, exact JSON keys, 80-100-word explanation, successful read of both files; synthetic prose retained for review.

blindedReview.rubric: Supplementary assistant review of synthetic explanations: factual consistency with fixture, agreement with structured answer, no material unsupported claim. Condition labels hidden during review; not independent human grading. Length and format assessed separately by deterministic grader.

launcherIncident: Frozen bundle also executed an imported legacy main, which failed before any API call (parent: missing --baseline; child: missing --model). Parent exited 1; all 36 measured tasks completed with 72 HTTP 200 responses, complete usage and no retries. Shared statistics were extracted afterward; corrected bundle passed an offline entrypoint smoke. Frozen artifacts were not replaced.
